{{Quote|Oldksam can help you. He is hiding out in the Krayt Cult cave.|[[Taibela]], to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]|<ref name="SWG:FJ" />}}
The '''Krayt Cult Cave''' was a cave in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the home of the [[Krayt Cult]] that worshiped [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]].<ref name="JDW">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Jabba's%20Dirty%20Work&resource=features|text=Jabba's Dirty Work}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Heh, heh. You were lucky to get through those cultists. Make sure you return those poison glands to Tori.|[[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bone Gnasher|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Krayt cultists inhabited the cave. They worshiped a large krayt dragon skull in the depth of the cave.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

[[File:Krayt_Cult_Cave.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Interior of the Krayt Cult Cave.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Tori Radeen]] asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to go into the cave and bring her the poison glands of [[bone gnasher]]s that lived in the cave. She used the glands to create a new poison for use by Jabba.<ref name="JDW" /> Around the same time, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Oldksam]] was hiding inside the cave because he thought the crime boss [[Faeto]] wanted to have him assassinated. A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked Oldksam down to the cave but only questioned him about a man known as [[Untas]], Faeto's real target.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> In the meantime, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Ellis Arrison]] ordered a young [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] to attack Krayt Cultists in their cave as part of his officer combat training.<ref name="SWG:OM1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Officer|Officer Mission 1|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Krayt Cult Cave appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Krayt Cult Cave was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the cut quest "Cult of the Krayt," [[Brannix Tzg'ada]] would have tasked a spacer with eliminating Krayt cultists in the
Krayt Cult Cave.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tatooine_eisley_brannix.st, tatooine_eisley_krayt_cult.stf</ref>
